paired.interpretation: Seed t intervals describe training variation. Image bootstrap intervals are conditional on one fitted seed. No multiplicity correction; no causal mediation claim.

interpretability.probe: Frozen TRAIN-only linear ridge mask predictor, applied to original x and residual-preserving x-native_group_contribution. Removal diagnoses a fitted readout; not causal ground-truth concept manipulation.
interpretability.consolidation: Greedy native-code subsets chosen on TRAIN only; held-out sum of native group contributions. Extra-group gain is not a feature-splitting rate; overlap/cancellation and context remain possible.
interpretability.controls: Four random groups sampled from 32 nearest TRAIN activity/contribution-RMS neighbors; matching distances/statistics retained, not exact energy matching.
interpretability.bootstrap: 1000 paired whole-image draws within model; seed SD/t intervals separate

data.selection: First SHA-ranked annotation-positive evaluation image; no performance filtering
data.colors: Signed coefficient coordinates are basis-dependent; contribution PCA fitted on TRAIN active patches; RGB encodes PCs, not photographic color. Display normalization is per model/group; intensity not comparable absolutely.
data.interpolation: Nearest-patch primary overlay, inactive patches transparent; no smoothing changes metrics
